Fixing FCSExpress Displaying FACSDiva Files 

Go to “File” and then “Options.” 

Graphical user interface, application, PowerPoint

Expand the sub-menu for “Data Loading.” 

 

 

Expand the sub-menu for “FCS File Options.”

Click on the “FCS File Options” tab and make sure that the “Allow opening BD FACSDiva data files that were generated by exporting a FACSDiva experiment” checkbox is checked.

Click “OK” and you should now be able to open files.
